draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Sorry we missed each other on the call last week - easy to let that slip in a busy stretch.

If it helps, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so that first one usually makes the rest fall into place. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Reply with a time that suits you and I'll set it up.

Best,
Nadia
